reviews.t: Very good razor for the price
reviews.x: Upgraded to this razor after my old Remington died, and I've been very happy with it.  It cut a bit close, which irritated my skin at first, but I think that was just me getting used to the "Lift & cut."  This would be an excellent razor if it wasn't for two features (or lack thereof) that make it a pain to use.  1.  The internal battery is NiCd.  This type of battery has "memory" to it, which means for optimal performance, the battery should be fully drained before you recharge it.  Otherwise,

I bought this to replace a Norelco 5885 XL after the battery stopped taking a charge. I had the 5885 repaired at a Philips authorized place, but it still didn't take much of a charge, so I went back again and, in the end, still didn't have a razor that I could use for more than a few days. I finally decided to give up and get this. I paid about $40 for it (the price has since gone up) and the repair was $30, so I figured this was a faster way to get something that worked.  In general, this is a

reviews.t: My Second Norelco Rechargable Shaving System
reviews.x: After ten years or so my original Norelco Chargable Razor gave up the ghost.  I tried to find a duplicate, the razor I choose is the subject of these comments.  I was amazed to see the improvements, not only in the features of the razor and its maintence program, but also in the quality of the shave I am now enjoying. In my eighty years as a consumer I have learned that new is not always better, but this experience was a plesant surprize.

Wow, I am shocked that so many people like this shaver, since it has proved utterly useless for me. It has no power whatsoever compared to my previous Norelco, and I can go over light stubble several times and still feel plenty that it has missed. Just turn it on and you can feel that it's a pretty wimpy motor inside. Plus the trimming blade is set at such an angle that it's very difficult to use without it closing on me all the time. Again, my previous Norelco had much better design/placement f

reviews.t: Would Be Better With Low Battery Indicator
reviews.x: I've been using this shaver for about a month now, and find its performance to be somewhat better than my previous Norelco shaver (5822) at this price point.  Not having a low battery indicator is the most serious deficiency of the 7140.  The instructions state:  "Battery performance is best if you recharge only when the batteries are (almost) completely empty."  If you follow this advice, it means you'll have a bad shave or two as the battery runs down, and then have to use it as a corded razor

This is a Great razor,my wife gave me one for Father's Day and I couldn't wait to use it.  After a four hour charge,per the directions, I got to use it.  Wonderfully close and pleasant shave.  What a treat!  Gunner  June, 2007

Seems like I've only owned about 3 or 4 shavers throughout my shaving career of 30+ years but I still remember an earlier Norelco whose ni-cad batteries never died.  My latest Norelco seemed to last only about 5 years but it is amazing how each generation of shavers is quieter.  This 7140XL is very quiet and almost seems like it isn't running very fast, but yet it does a great job.  I've had it about 3+ weeks and I'm still running on the original charge.  All my previous Norelco's had a plain st

I've tried more expensive shavers over the years, and this one yields as close a shave as any of them.  It's also very easy to clean by running a tap over it.  Corded operation is a real plus, because in my experience the rechargable battery will be just about useless by the time the second set of replacement heads wears out.  I can't give it 5 stars, because its results can be improved by following up with a blade (just as with every other electric I've tried), but it's a great value for the pr

Bought this to replace another Norelco shaver that was a few years old and needed new heads (HQ55 Heads, which I was never very happy with). This shaver has the HQ8 heads, which I think are Norelco's best design. As mentioned by other reviewers, this shaver is very quiet- disturbingly so. You think it can't possibly be doing anything. It has given me the closest shave ever with an electric razor (which is all I use) with absolutely zero skin irritation. It even works well on the hard to get clos

reviews.t: Shaving has become like wrestling a chainsaw
reviews.x: I've had my shaveer for about a week and have given it several opportunities to do well.  I've worn out 3 Norelco shavers so this was a confident purchase I thought.  This razor grabs chunks of flesh and heaves it around the room as if the objective is to destroy my face rather than shave it.  I have tried to exercise the utmost care to keep this thing from ripping my face apart, but it continues to do it at least 4 times each shave, and with nothing more happening than just moving to another pl
Overall, it's a good razor.  It functions and it's very quiet.  Sometimes I need to plug it in for extra juice when the battery is low (there is no indicator, you just feel it).  It's also very blue.

I have had this razor for perhaps 6 months and wish I would have had the sense to return it within the 30 days allowed.  The main problem is the low speed at which this razor runs.  Previous Norelcos that I have owned ran at much higher speeds and cut far more efficiently.  The 7140 is hell on the neck, particularly with a 2 day growth and tends to pull hairs rather than cut them.  I would pass on this razor unless you have a light beard.  Don't ignore the 30 day return policy if you do decide t

reviews.t: Does not work good for me
reviews.x: The problem I have with this shaver is that it does not do a thorough job. It's been now 2 months that I bought it. Some times I have to go over a spot over and over and over again... And the shave is not very close as I expected to be. My father had a Philips shaver (15 years old) that I tried 5 years ago and that machine did more thorough job than this new technology thing. Anyhow... I'm going back to old way.

I am going from the Braun 7526 electric to this. This thing is incredibly under powered and for me very hard to get a close shave.  Charge time is 8+ hours for only 30 minutes of battery life, you've got to be kidding right.  I am returning this thing (although amazon does not have a very good return policy) and ordering the Braun.

reviews.t: Not as good as the old one.
reviews.x: I had to purchase a new electric razor because my charger for my old Norelco was damaged in an electrical storm. I must say the new model is much lighter, however the quality of the shave and the harshness on my face is less than acceptible. I prefer the older model.

I BOUGHT THE NORELCO 7140XL AND I LOVE IT. I CAN'T WAIT TO SHAVE EACH DAY. THIS RAZOR IS SO QUIET AND SHAVES REAL CLOSE. I DO USE ELECTRIC SHAVE. IT IS LIGHT AND I LIKE THE COLOR AND DESIGN. I WOULD HIGHLY RECOMMEND THIS SHAVER TO ANYONE.
It does not work like I thought it would. It leaves hair and you break out with irritation badly. I would not buy again. I will stick with a real razor.

reviews.t: Not for shaky hands and takes too long to charge
reviews.x: I have just "had it" with my second 7140XL.  I bought both for $29.95 on sale at CVS.  While it shaves good, there are two problems. The first is that the "charged" light does not go on when fully charged.  Morever it does not hold a charge very long.  The major problem involves cleaning this razor. I have shaky hands and fingers. Other than rinsing with hot water, one must remove the top lock and then clean each head.  With my first copy, I could not get the top lock back on. Moreover two of th

I've used Norelco products since I first started shaving 20 years ago.  Each time I get a new one they get better and better.  The Norelco 7140XL is no exception.  The new features I am experiencing with this model are light weight, quiet, rinsable, and the way the whole razor head pivots inward (I'm not sure if this is their Precision Cutting System, Superior Lift & Cut Technology, or Patented Reflex Action Shaving System)when you press it to your face.  Great product.  Would recommend it to an

This really has been one of the most disappointing things I've purchased through amazon. Major cons :: (1)Shaving time is too much (2)Shaves from the root(bad when someone wants to leave a little stubble). Doesn't have any level setting for leaving a bit stubble. (3)Even after spending so much time, doesn't give a clean shave..leave a few hair here n there. I bought this shaver with high expectations, but honestly I've been disappointed by the results. Not value for money.

I have been using Norelco shavers for 30+ years and have had this one for about 30 days.  As usual this unit provides an excellent shave, close without irritation.  However, for the first time I am less impressed with the build quality.  The unit feels cheap.  It rattles, the plastics feel inferior and the clipper doesn't retract tightly into the housing. Only time will tell as to how well it holds up.  Battery life has been excellent.

Ordered this shaver after my old unit suddenly quit.  Should have heeded the previous review that this unit lacks the power (and I think speed) of the older Norelco's.  I have since ordered a pair of NiCad batteries for about $8 and repaired my old Norelco - what I should have done in the first place.  I guess I'll keep this new one as a backup but it is not my first choice.  It shaves clean, but is kind of slow and gutless.

I have been using this razor for 2 months and lately I have been getting a lot of irritation and pimples. This razor does not get the stubborn more thick hairs like my old 35$ norelco used to-which I had used for 4 years. If it is not fully charged or plugged in, the razor is hopeless to get a clean shave on a partial charge. I have to go over areas many times.

I bought this shaver to replace my old Norelco, which still worked OK, but was tricky to charge.  The 7140XL shaves closer and is much quieter and lighter.  I've used it for about a month and have only positive feedback to report.  Time will tell if the design will hold up.  I also like that the blades hinge up when opened for cleaning.

I had a rechargeable Norelco that I bought at a garage sale for a buck. It gave me years of good service but finally died. I decided to give this one a try and I am very pleased. I have a lite beard but still need to shave every day and this shaver leaves my face nice and smooth. The battery charge lasts a long time.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the razor a good value and a close, pleasant shave for the price.
Several reviewers complain the razor is underpowered and does not give a close or thorough shave.
Some reviewers report skin irritation or harshness on the face.
Reviewers note the lack of a low battery indicator as a deficiency.
The razor is frequently described as very quiet.
